name: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)
evidence: The official About Us page identifies BARC as a multidisciplinary nuclear research centre established as the Atomic Energy Establishment, Trombay, while the site identifies it as part of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India.
notes: Normal TLS verification failed with the managed proxy's self-signed certificate chain; used curl --insecure only for public GET requests to www.barc.gov.in.
